title.zh: Morning Minute: BlackRock Leans Deeper Into Tokenization with Ondo
title.en: Morning Minute: BlackRock Leans Deeper Into Tokenization with Ondo

current_state.zh: BlackRock deepened its tokenization push by building three portfolio strategies for Ondo that each trade as a single token, alongside a newsletter roundup noting a confirmed $350M BitGet drain and a Magic Eden contract exploit.
